title: North Carolina Department of Revenue
purpose: The state agency that administers North Carolina income, sales, withholding and other state taxes.
notes: Homepage only. Domain confirmed via many official ncdor.gov search results; NCDOR's own pages direct taxpayers to www.ncdor.gov. Fetching blocked in this environment.

title: NCDOR eServices (online file and pay)
purpose: Lists NCDOR's online services for filing returns and making tax payments.
notes: Also see File & Pay hub https://www.ncdor.gov/file-pay. Search also returned https://electronic-services.dor.nc.gov/ (state .gov host) for application access.

title: Individual Income Tax Forms & Instructions
purpose: Provides North Carolina individual income tax forms and instructions.
notes: Related official pages: filing requirements https://www.ncdor.gov/taxes-forms/individual-income-tax/individual-income-filing-requirements and File & Pay for Individuals https://www.ncdor.gov/file-pay/file-pay-individuals.

title: Corporate Income and Franchise Tax
purpose: Explains North Carolina corporate income tax and franchise tax rates and rules.
notes: Rates page within the Corporate Income & Franchise Tax section (section landing page itself did not appear as a result). NC levies both corporate income tax and franchise tax.

title: Overview of Sales and Use Taxes
purpose: Explains North Carolina sales and use tax, with links to rates, forms and filing.
notes: Online filing: https://www.ncdor.gov/taxes-forms/sales-and-use-tax/efile-and-pay-your-sales-and-use-tax ; current rates: https://www.ncdor.gov/taxes-forms/sales-and-use-tax/sales-and-use-tax-rates/current-sales-and-use-tax-rates.

title: Withholding Tax
purpose: Employer guidance, forms and filing information for North Carolina income tax withholding.
notes: Online filing: https://www.ncdor.gov/file-pay/file-and-pay-your-withholding-tax-online. New employers register via Form NC-BR / online business registration (https://www.ncdor.gov/registration).

title: DES Employers (Unemployment Insurance Tax)
purpose: Information for employers on registering for, reporting and paying North Carolina unemployment insurance tax.
notes: Tax filing/payments are handled in DES's NCSUITS system (named in DES text; direct URL not confirmed). Tax rate info: https://des.nc.gov/employers/tax-rate-information.

title: Business Registration - Register Your Business
purpose: Explains how to register a corporation, LLC, partnership or other entity with the NC Secretary of State.
agency: North Carolina Department of the Secretary of State - Business Registration Division
notes: Business Registration forms: https://www.sosnc.gov/forms/by_title/_Business_Registration.

title: Business Annual Report
purpose: File the annual report required for NC corporations, LLCs, LLPs and LLLPs online.
agency: North Carolina Department of the Secretary of State
notes: Due dates vary by entity type (see page).

title: Licenses & Permits (no general state business license)
purpose: Explains that NC has no single general business license and how to find industry-specific licenses.
agency: North Carolina Department of the Secretary of State
notes: Official SOS text: 'North Carolina has no single generic business license.' Licenses depend on occupation/industry; local permits may apply.

title: ABC Commission - General Permit Information
purpose: Explains North Carolina ABC permits and how to apply for retail, commercial and special-event permits.
agency: North Carolina Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) Commission
notes: Online permit registration (one-time permits) at https://aps.abc.nc.gov/PermitType.

title: Alcoholic Beverages Tax Forms and Instructions
purpose: Forms and instructions for filing North Carolina alcoholic beverages (beer and wine) excise tax returns.
agency: North Carolina Department of Revenue (NCDOR) - Excise Tax Division
notes: NCDOR collects beer/wine excise from wholesalers/importers. Spirituous liquor tax is handled through local ABC boards/ABC system per NCDOR FAQ.

title: Nonprofit Corporations
purpose: Explains how to form a North Carolina nonprofit corporation with the Secretary of State.
agency: North Carolina Department of the Secretary of State - Business Registration Division
notes: Articles of Incorporation for nonprofits (Form N-01) are in the Business Registration forms list.

title: Charities Division - Licensing
purpose: License for charitable organizations that solicit contributions in North Carolina.
agency: North Carolina Department of the Secretary of State - Charities Division
notes: Annual renewal required; exemptions exist (see page).

title: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner
purpose: The state agency that administers North Dakota income, sales, withholding and other state taxes.
agency: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner
notes: Homepage only; many official tax.nd.gov pages appeared as search results. North Dakota's tax agency is the Office of State Tax Commissioner, not a 'Department of Revenue'.

title: ND TAP (Taxpayer Access Point)
purpose: Online portal to file and pay North Dakota business taxes and make income tax payments.
agency: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner
notes: Info page. The login itself is at tap.tax.nd.gov (named in official sign-up materials; official instructions also use tax.nd.gov/tap) - not opened. Corporate income tax returns are not filed in ND TAP per 2025 booklet, though payments can be made there.

title: Individual Income Tax
purpose: North Dakota individual income tax information, rates, forms and filing.
agency: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner

title: Corporate Income Tax
purpose: North Dakota corporate income tax information and forms (Form 40).
agency: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner
notes: Pass-through entities: https://www.tax.nd.gov/business/s-corp-and-partnership-tax.

title: Sales and Use Tax
purpose: North Dakota sales and use tax information, permits and filing.
agency: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner
notes: Returns are filed and paid digitally through ND TAP.

title: Income Tax Withholding
purpose: Employer guidance for registering, filing and paying North Dakota income tax withholding.
agency: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner

title: Unemployment Business Tax - Employer's Guide
purpose: Explains employer registration, quarterly reporting and payment of North Dakota unemployment insurance tax.
notes: Registration and quarterly reports are filed online via Job Service's UI EASY portal (named in official text; URL not confirmed). File reports page: https://www.jobsnd.com/unemployment-business-tax/file-reports.

title: Register a Business
purpose: Explains how to register a business entity with the North Dakota Secretary of State.
notes: Filings are made through the FirstStop portal: https://firststop.sos.nd.gov/ (official-result).

title: FirstStop - Online Business Services (annual reports)
purpose: Online portal used to file annual reports and other filings with the North Dakota Secretary of State.
notes: Due dates differ by entity type; e.g., LLC annual report page: https://sos.nd.gov/business/business-services/business-structures/limited-liability-companies/limited-liability-company-llc/llc-annual-report. Nonprofits: https://www.sos.nd.gov/business/nonprofit-services/maintain-nonprofit.

title: Licensing and Registration (no general state business license)
purpose: Explains which North Dakota businesses need a specific state license or registration.
notes: Official ND guidance states most businesses are not required to obtain a license to operate; licenses are industry-specific (e.g., contractors, liquor). No general state business license.

title: Retail Alcoholic Beverage License
purpose: State retail alcoholic beverage license issued by the Attorney General (a local license is required first).
agency: North Dakota Attorney General - Licensing Section
notes: Retail licenses only. Wholesaler, supplier and manufacturer licenses are issued by the Office of State Tax Commissioner (see ALCOHOL_TAX entry).

title: Alcohol Tax
purpose: North Dakota alcohol excise tax filing plus wholesaler, supplier and manufacturer licensing.
agency: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner
notes: Tax Commissioner handles both the alcohol excise tax and non-retail alcohol licenses (via ND TAP).

title: North Dakota Nonprofit
purpose: Explains how to register a North Dakota nonprofit corporation or nonprofit LLC.

title: Charitable Organizations
purpose: Registration for charitable organizations that solicit contributions in North Dakota.
notes: Separate charitable annual report is required: https://sos.nd.gov/business/nonprofit-services/charitable-organizations-soliciting-contributions/required-solicitation-reports.
